steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: Chemistry teacher Walter White learns he has terminal lung cancer. He teams up with his former student Jesse Pinkman to cook meth in an RV. A first deal goes wrong and Walt gasses Krazy-8 and Emilio.

steps.title: Cat's in the Bag...
steps.text: Emilio is dead, but Krazy-8 survived and is locked in Jesse's basement. Jesse dissolves Emilio's body in a bathtub, which falls through the floor.

steps.title: ...And the Bag's in the River
steps.text: After days of doubt, Walt kills Krazy-8 when he realises Krazy-8 hid a shard of a broken plate to stab him.

steps.title: Cancer Man
steps.text: Walt tells his family he has cancer. Jesse spends a few tense days at his parents' house. Walt blows up the car of a rude driver.

steps.title: Gray Matter
steps.text: Walt turns down Elliott and Gretchen's offer to pay for his treatment. He goes back to cooking with Jesse.

steps.title: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
steps.text: Walt shaves his head, calls himself Heisenberg and blows up Tuco's office with fulminated mercury. Tuco agrees to buy their product.

steps.title: A No-Rough-Stuff-Type Deal
steps.text: Walt and Jesse steal a barrel of methylamine. At the junkyard deal Tuco beats his own man No-Doze to death.

steps.title: Seven Thirty-Seven
steps.text: Tuco beats one of his own men to death in front of Walt and Jesse. Sure they're next, they plan to poison him with ricin before he takes them away.

steps.title: Grilled
steps.text: Tuco kidnaps Walt and Jesse to a desert shack where his uncle Hector lives. Hank tracks Jesse's car there and shoots Tuco dead.

steps.title: Bit by a Dead Bee
steps.text: Walt fakes a fugue state to explain his disappearance. Jesse is out of his house and on his own.

steps.title: Down
steps.text: Jesse loses his house and ends up sleeping rough. Walt and Skyler drift apart. Walt and Jesse fight, then agree to keep going.

steps.title: Breakage
steps.text: Jesse puts his friends Badger, Skinny Pete and Combo on the street to sell. Hank has panic attacks after Tuco.

steps.title: Peekaboo
steps.text: Jesse goes to collect from two addicts, Spooge and his partner. She crushes Spooge's head with a stolen ATM.

steps.title: Negro y Azul
steps.text: Word spreads that Jesse killed Spooge, which helps business. Hank is sent to El Paso and sees a cartel informant's head on a tortoise. Jesse falls for Jane.

steps.title: Better Call Saul
steps.text: Badger is caught in a sting. Walt and Jesse hire the slippery lawyer Saul Goodman, who finds a way to get him out.

steps.title: 4 Days Out
steps.text: The RV's battery dies on a long cook in the desert. Walt builds a battery from scratch to get them home.

steps.title: Over
steps.text: Walt's cancer is in remission. He tears into home repairs, lets Walter Jr. drink too much, and warns off two would-be cooks in a hardware store.

steps.title: Mandala
steps.text: Combo is shot by a rival dealer. Saul arranges a meeting with the careful distributor Gus Fring. Jesse and Jane use heroin, and Walt misses his daughter's birth to make a delivery.

steps.title: Phoenix
steps.text: Jane blackmails Walt over Jesse's share. Walt finds Jesse and Jane high and watches Jane choke to death without helping.

steps.title: ABQ
steps.text: Jane's grieving father Donald, an air traffic controller, causes two planes to collide over Albuquerque. Skyler figures out Walt has lied and moves to separate.

steps.title: No Más
steps.text: Walt tells Skyler he makes drugs. Two silent cousins from the cartel cross the border to kill Walt for Tuco's death.

steps.title: Caballo sin Nombre
steps.text: Walt is arrested after a traffic stop and won't move out. The cousins wait in his house with an axe but are called off at the last moment.

steps.title: I.F.T.
steps.text: Walt moves back into the house against Skyler's wishes. She starts an affair with her boss Ted Beneke.

steps.title: Green Light
steps.text: Walt loses his teaching job. Jesse cooks a batch with Walt's recipe and asks Saul to sell it.

steps.title: Más
steps.text: Gus offers Walt three million dollars for three months of cooking. Walt says yes.

steps.title: Sunset
steps.text: Walt starts cooking in Gus's hidden superlab under an industrial laundry, with Gale Boetticher as his assistant. Hank closes in on the RV, which is destroyed.

steps.title: One Minute
steps.text: Hank beats Jesse up. Later the cousins ambush Hank in a parking lot; Hank kills one and is badly wounded.

steps.title: I See You
steps.text: Hank survives surgery. The surviving cousin is killed in his hospital bed.

steps.title: Kafkaesque
steps.text: Hank faces a long recovery. Skyler invents a gambling story to explain how they can pay for it. Jesse plans to sell on the side through Badger and Skinny Pete.

steps.title: Fly
steps.text: Walt won't cook until a fly is out of the lab. He nearly tells Jesse about the night Jane died.

steps.title: Abiquiu
steps.text: Skyler joins the money laundering plan and pushes to buy a car wash. Jesse meets Andrea, a mother of a young son, Brock.

steps.title: Half Measures
steps.text: Jesse learns the dealers who used Andrea's little brother are Gus's men. Walt runs them over and shoots one to save Jesse.

steps.title: Full Measure
steps.text: Gus means to replace Walt with Gale. Walt has Jesse kill Gale to make himself irreplaceable.

steps.title: Box Cutter
steps.text: Gus slits Victor's throat with a box cutter in front of Walt and Jesse as a warning.

steps.title: Thirty-Eight Snub
steps.text: Walt buys a revolver, meaning to kill Gus. Jesse throws nonstop parties at his house.

steps.title: Open House
steps.text: Skyler negotiates for the car wash. Hank gets Gale's lab notebook from the police.

steps.title: Bullet Points
steps.text: Hank studies Gale's lab notebook and wonders who 'W.W.' is.

steps.title: Shotgun
steps.text: Mike takes Jesse on pickup runs and stages a robbery Jesse stops. Over dinner Walt says Gale was no genius, and Hank starts digging again.

steps.title: Cornered
steps.text: Skyler wants the family to run. Walt tells her he is the one who knocks.

steps.title: Problem Dog
steps.text: Jesse is given ricin to use on Gus. Hank gets Walt to drive him to Los Pollos Hermanos and takes Gus's fingerprints.

steps.title: Hermanos
steps.text: Gus's past comes out: the cartel killed his partner Max in front of him years ago, and Hector laughed.

steps.title: Bug
steps.text: Hank has Walt plant a tracker on Gus's car. A cartel sniper kills one of Gus's men. Walt and Jesse come to blows.

steps.title: Salud
steps.text: Jesse cooks for the cartel in Mexico. Gus poisons Don Eladio and his men with tainted tequila.

steps.title: Crawl Space
steps.text: Skyler gave Walt's money to Ted, who is hurt fleeing her people. Gus tells Walt he will kill his family.

steps.title: End Times
steps.text: Brock is seriously ill and Jesse thinks Gus poisoned him with the ricin cigarette. Walt plants a bomb on Gus's car, but Gus senses it.

steps.title: Face Off
steps.text: Walt and Hector set a bell-triggered bomb at the nursing home that kills Gus and Tyrus. They burn the lab. A plant on Walt's patio shows he poisoned Brock himself.

steps.title: Live Free or Die
steps.text: Walt, Jesse and Mike wipe Gus's laptop evidence at the police station with a huge magnet.

steps.title: Madrigal
steps.text: Mike is questioned about Gus. Lydia, a nervous Madrigal executive, tries to have Mike's men killed.

steps.title: Hazard Pay
steps.text: Walt, Jesse and Mike restart the business, cooking in houses tented by the pest control firm Vamonos Pest, where Todd works.

steps.title: Fifty-One
steps.text: On Walt's 51st birthday Skyler walks into the pool. Lydia plants a tracker on a methylamine barrel.

steps.title: Dead Freight
steps.text: They rob a train of methylamine. Todd shoots a boy who saw them.

steps.title: Buyout
steps.text: Mike and Jesse want to sell their share of the methylamine. Walt refuses to give it up.

steps.title: Say My Name
steps.text: Walt kills Mike by the river after Mike won't give up his men's names.

steps.title: Gliding Over All
steps.text: Todd's uncle Jack's crew kill Mike's men in prisons within two minutes. Walt quits. Hank finds a book inscribed to 'W.W.'

steps.title: Blood Money
steps.text: Hank confronts Walt in his garage.

steps.title: Buried
steps.text: Skyler sides with Walt. Walt buries his money in the desert. Jesse is picked up after throwing cash out of his car.

steps.title: Confessions
steps.text: Walt records a fake confession blaming Hank. Jesse works out that Walt poisoned Brock.

steps.title: Rabid Dog
steps.text: Jesse tries to burn down Walt's house, then agrees to help Hank catch him. Walt asks Jack's crew to kill Jesse.

steps.title: To'hajiilee
steps.text: Hank and Gomez arrest Walt at his buried money. Jack's crew arrive and a shootout starts.

steps.title: Ozymandias
steps.text: Jack kills Hank; Gomez is dead too. Jesse is taken prisoner to cook. Walt's family turns on him and he leaves town with the help of Ed, the disappearer.

steps.title: Granite State
steps.text: Walt hides in New Hampshire. Todd shoots Andrea to keep Jesse in line.

steps.title: Felina
steps.text: Walt returns, poisons Lydia with ricin, kills Jack's crew with a hidden machine gun and frees Jesse. Walt dies in the lab.
